'''Deep-sea grapes''' were a type of [[Grape/Legends|grape]] used to produce a local [[Unidentified wine (Kalimahr)|wine]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalimahr/Legends|Kalimahr]].<ref name="Into the Void" />

{{Food-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Deep-sea grapes were first mentioned in ''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]'', a [[2013]] novel written by [[Tim Lebbon]].<ref name="Into the Void" />
